verses.en: Now after the death of Joshua it came to pass, that the children of Israel asked the LORD, saying, Who shall go up for us against the Canaanites first, to fight against them?
verses.pt: E aconteceu depois da morte de Josué, que os filhos de Israel consultaram ao SENHOR, dizendo: Quem subirá por nós primeiro para lutar contra os cananeus?
verses.en_web: After the death of Joshua, the children of Israel asked of Yahweh, saying, “Who should go up for us first against the Canaanites, to fight against them?”
verses.en_bbe: Now after the death of Joshua, the children of Israel made request to the Lord, saying, Who is to go up first to make war for us against the Canaanites?

verses.en: And the LORD said, Judah shall go up: behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR respondeu: Judá subirá; eis que eu entreguei a terra em suas mãos.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said, “Judah shall go up. Behold, I have delivered the land into his hand.”
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, Judah is to go up: see, I have given the land into his hands.

verses.en: And Judah said unto Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with thee into thy lot. So Simeon went with him.
verses.pt: E Judá disse a Simeão seu irmão: Sobe comigo à minha porção, e lutemos contra os cananeus, e eu também irei contigo à tua porção. E Simeão foi com ele.
verses.en_web: Judah said to Simeon his brother, “Come up with me into my lot, that we may fight against the Canaanites; and I likewise will go with you into your lot.” So Simeon went with him.
verses.en_bbe: Then Judah said to Simeon his brother, Come up with me into my heritage, so that we may make war against the Canaanites; and I will then go with you into your heritage. So Simeon went with him.

verses.en: And Judah went up; and the LORD delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand: and they slew of them in Bezek ten thousand men.
verses.pt: E subiu Judá, e o SENHOR entregou em suas mãos aos cananeus e aos perizeus; e deles feriram em Bezeque dez mil homens.
verses.en_web: Judah went up, and Yahweh delivered the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hand. They struck ten thousand men in Bezek.
verses.en_bbe: And Judah went up; and the Lord gave the Canaanites and the Perizzites into their hands; and they overcame ten thousand of them in Bezek.

verses.en: And they found Adoni-bezek in Bezek: and they fought against him, and they slew the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.pt: E acharam a Adoni-Bezeque em Bezeque, e lutaram contra ele: e feriram aos cananeus e aos perizeus.
verses.en_web: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
verses.en_bbe: And they came across Adoni-zedek, and made war on him; and they overcame the Canaanites and the Perizzites.

verses.en: But Adoni-bezek fled; and they pursued after him, and caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his great toes.
verses.pt: Mas Adoni-Bezeque fugiu; e seguiram-no, e prenderam-no, e cortaram-lhe os polegares das mãos e dos pés.
verses.en_web: But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.
verses.en_bbe: But Adoni-zedek went in flight; and they went after him and overtook him, and had his thumbs and his great toes cut off.

verses.en: And Adoni-bezek said, Threescore and ten kings, having their thumbs and their great toes cut off, gathered their meat under my table: as I have done, so God hath requited me. And they brought him to Jerusalem, and there he died.
verses.pt: Então disse Adoni-Bezeque: Setenta reis, cortados os polegares de suas mãos e de seus pés, colhiam as migalhas debaixo de minha mesa: como eu fiz, assim Deus me pagou. E meteram-no em Jerusalém, de onde morreu.
verses.en_web: Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
verses.en_bbe: And Adoni-zedek said, Seventy kings, whose thumbs and great toes had been cut off, got broken meat under my table: as I have done, so has God done to me in full. And they took him to Jerusalem, and he came to his end there.

verses.en: Now the children of Judah had fought against Jerusalem, and had taken it, and smitten it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
verses.pt: E combateram os filhos de Judá a Jerusalém, e a tomaram, e puseram à espada, e puseram a fogo a cidade.
verses.en_web: The children of Judah fought against Jerusalem, took it, struck it with the edge of the sword, and set the city on fire.
verses.en_bbe: Then the children of Judah made an attack on Jerusalem, and took it, burning down the town after they had put its people to the sword without mercy.

verses.en: And afterward the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites, that dwelt in the mountain, and in the south, and in the valley.
verses.pt: Depois os filhos de Judá desceram para lutar contra os cananeus que habitavam nas montanhas, e ao sul, e nas planícies.
verses.en_web: After that, the children of Judah went down to fight against the Canaanites who lived in the hill country, and in the South, and in the lowland.
verses.en_bbe: After that the children of Judah went down to make war on the Canaanites living in the hill-country and in the south and in the lowlands.

verses.en: And Judah went against the Canaanites that dwelt in Hebron: (now the name of Hebron before was Kirjath-arba:) and they slew Sheshai, and Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.pt: E partiu Judá contra os cananeus que habitavam em Hebrom, a qual se chamava antes Quiriate-Arba; e feriram a Sesai, e a Aimã, e a Talmai.
verses.en_web: Judah went against the Canaanites who lived in Hebron. (The name of Hebron before that was Kiriath Arba.) They struck Sheshai, Ahiman, and Talmai.
verses.en_bbe: And Caleb went against the Canaanites of Hebron: (now in earlier times Hebron was named Kiriath-arba:) and he put Sheshai and Ahiman and Talmai to the sword.

verses.en: And from thence he went against the inhabitants of Debir: and the name of Debir before was Kirjath-sepher:
verses.pt: E dali foi aos que habitavam em Debir, que antes se chamava Quiriate-Sefer.
verses.en_web: From there he went against the inhabitants of Debir. (The name of Debir before that was Kiriath Sepher.)
verses.en_bbe: And from there he went up against the people of Debir. (Now the name of Debir in earlier times was Kiriath-sepher.)

verses.en: And Caleb said, He that smiteth Kirjath-sepher, and taketh it, to him will I give Achsah my daughter to wife.
verses.pt: E disse Calebe: O que ferir a Quiriate-Sefer, e a tomar, eu lhe darei a Acsa minha filha por mulher.
verses.en_web: Caleb said, “I will give Achsah my daughter as wife to the man who strikes Kiriath Sepher, and takes it.”
verses.en_bbe: And Caleb said, I will give Achsah, my daughter, as wife to the man who overcomes Kiriath-sepher and takes it.

verses.en: And Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it: and he gave him Achsah his daughter to wife.
verses.pt: E tomou-a Otniel filho de Quenaz, irmão menor de Calebe: e ele lhe deu a Acsa sua filha por mulher.
verses.en_web: Othniel the son of Kenaz, Caleb’s younger brother, took it, so he gave him Achsah his daughter as his wife.
verses.en_bbe: And Othniel, the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother, took it; so he gave him his daughter Achsah for his wife.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when she came to him, that she moved him to ask of her father a field: and she lighted from off her ass; and Caleb said unto her, What wilt thou?
verses.pt: E quando a levavam, persuadiu-lhe que pedisse a seu pai um campo. E ela desceu do asno, e Calebe lhe disse: Que tens?
verses.en_web: When she came, she got him to ask her father for a field. She got off her donkey; and Caleb said to her, “What would you like?”
verses.en_bbe: Now when she came to him, he put into her mind the idea of requesting a field from her father: and she got down from her ass; and Caleb said to her, What is it?

verses.en: And she said unto him, Give me a blessing: for thou hast given me a south land; give me also springs of water. And Caleb gave her the upper springs and the nether springs.
verses.pt: Ela então lhe respondeu: Dá-me uma bênção: pois me deste terra de secura, que me dês também fontes de águas. Então Calebe lhe deu as fontes de acima e as fontes de abaixo.
verses.en_web: She said to him, “Give me a blessing; because you have set me in the land of the South, give me also springs of water.” Then Caleb gave her the upper springs and the lower springs.
verses.en_bbe: And she said to him, Give me a blessing; because you have put me in a dry south-land, now give me springs of water. So Caleb gave her the higher spring and the lower spring.

verses.en: And the children of the Kenite, Moses’ father in law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which lieth in the south of Arad; and they went and dwelt among the people.
verses.pt: E os filhos de queneu, sogro de Moisés, subiram da cidade das palmeiras com os filhos de Judá ao deserto de Judá, que está ao sul de Arade: e foram e habitaram com o povo.
verses.en_web: The children of the Kenite, Moses’ brother-in-law, went up out of the city of palm trees with the children of Judah into the wilderness of Judah, which is in the south of Arad; and they went and lived with the people.
verses.en_bbe: Now Hobab the Kenite, Moses' father-in-law, had come up out of the town of palm-trees, with the children of Judah, into the waste land of Arad; and he went and was living among the Amalekites;

verses.en: And Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they slew the Canaanites that inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. And the name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.pt: E foi Judá ao seu irmão Simeão, e feriram aos cananeus que habitavam em Zefate, e assolaram-na: e puseram por nome à cidade, Hormá.
verses.en_web: Judah went with Simeon his brother, and they struck the Canaanites who inhabited Zephath, and utterly destroyed it. The name of the city was called Hormah.
verses.en_bbe: And Judah went with Simeon, his brother, and overcame the Canaanites living in Zephath, and put it under the curse; and he gave the town the name of Hormah.

verses.en: Also Judah took Gaza with the coast thereof, and Askelon with the coast thereof, and Ekron with the coast thereof.
verses.pt: Tomou também Judá a Gaza com seu termo, e a Asquelom com seu termo, e a Ecrom com seu termo.
verses.en_web: Also Judah took Gaza with its border, and Ashkelon with its border, and Ekron with its border.
verses.en_bbe: Then Judah took Gaza and its limit, and Ashkelon and its limit, and Ekron and its limit.

verses.en: And the LORD was with Judah; and he drave out the inhabitants of the mountain; but could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR foi com Judá, e expulsaram os das montanhas; mas não puderam expulsar os que habitavam nas planícies, os quais tinham carros de ferro.
verses.en_web: Yahweh was with Judah; and drove out the inhabitants of the hill country; for he could not drive out the inhabitants of the valley, because they had chariots of iron.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord was with Judah; and he took the hill-country for his heritage; but he was unable to make the people of the valley go out, for they had war-carriages of iron.

verses.en: And they gave Hebron unto Caleb, as Moses said: and he expelled thence the three sons of Anak.
verses.pt: E deram Hebrom a Calebe, como Moisés havia dito: e ele expulsou dali três filhos de Anaque.
verses.en_web: They gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said, and he drove the three sons of Anak out of there.
verses.en_bbe: And they gave Hebron to Caleb, as Moses had said; and he took the land of the three sons of Anak, driving them out from there.

verses.en: And the children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites that inhabited Jerusalem; but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem unto this day.
verses.pt: Mas aos jebuseus que habitavam em Jerusalém, não expulsaram os filhos de Benjamim, e tanto os jebuseus habitaram com os filhos de Benjamim em Jerusalém até hoje.
verses.en_web: The children of Benjamin did not drive out the Jebusites who inhabited Jerusalem, but the Jebusites dwell with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem to this day.
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Judah did not make the Jebusites who were living in Jerusalem go out; the Jebusites are still living with the children of Benjamin in Jerusalem.

verses.en: And the house of Joseph, they also went up against Bethel: and the LORD was with them.
verses.pt: Também os da casa de José subiram a Betel; e o SENHOR foi com eles.
verses.en_web: The house of Joseph also went up against Bethel, and Yahweh was with them.
verses.en_bbe: And the family of Joseph went up against Beth-el, and the Lord was with them.

verses.en: And the house of Joseph sent to descry Bethel. (Now the name of the city before was Luz.)
verses.pt: E os da casa de José puseram espias em Betel, a qual cidade antes se chamava Luz.
verses.en_web: The house of Joseph sent to spy out Bethel. (The name of the city before that was Luz.)
verses.en_bbe: So they sent men to make a search round Beth-el. (Now the name of the town in earlier times was Luz.)

verses.en: And the spies saw a man come forth out of the city, and they said unto him, Shew us, we pray thee, the entrance into the city, and we will shew thee mercy.
verses.pt: E os que espiavam viram um homem que saía da cidade, e disseram-lhe: Mostra-nos agora a entrada da cidade, e faremos contigo misericórdia.
verses.en_web: The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”
verses.en_bbe: And the watchers saw a man coming out of the town, and said to him, If you will make clear to us the way into the town, we will be kind to you.

verses.en: And when he shewed them the entrance into the city, they smote the city with the edge of the sword; but they let go the man and all his family.
verses.pt: E ele lhes mostrou a entrada à cidade, e feriram-na a fio de espada; mas deixaram a aquele homem com toda sua família.
verses.en_web: He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.
verses.en_bbe: So he made clear to them the way into the town, and they put it to the sword; but they let the man and all his family get away safe.

verses.en: And the man went into the land of the Hittites, and built a city, and called the name thereof Luz: which is the name thereof unto this day.
verses.pt: E fosse o homem à terra dos heteus, e edificou uma cidade, à qual chamou Luz; e este é seu nome até hoje.
verses.en_web: The man went into the land of the Hittites, built a city, and called its name Luz, which is its name to this day.
verses.en_bbe: And he went into the land of the Hittites, building a town there and naming it Luz: which is its name to this day.

verses.en: Neither did Manasseh drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shean and her towns, nor Taanach and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and her towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and her towns: but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.pt: Tampouco Manassés expulsou os de Bete-Seã, nem aos de suas aldeias, nem aos de Taanaque e suas aldeias, nem os de Dor e suas aldeias, nem os habitantes de Ibleão e suas aldeias, nem aos que habitavam em Megido e em suas aldeias; mas os cananeus quiseram habitar nessa terra.
verses.en_web: Manasseh did not drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shean and its towns, nor Taanach and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Dor and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Ibleam and its towns, nor the inhabitants of Megiddo and its towns; but the Canaanites would dwell in that land.
verses.en_bbe: And Manasseh did not take away the land of the people of Beth-shean and its daughter-towns, or of Taanach and its daughter-towns, or of the people of Dor and its daughter-towns, or of the people of Ibleam and its daughter-towns, or of the people of Megiddo and its daughter-towns, driving them out; but the Canaanites would go on living in that land.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when Israel was strong, that they put the Canaanites to tribute, and did not utterly drive them out.
verses.pt: Porém quando Israel tomou forças fez aos cananeus tributários, mas não o expulsou.
verses.en_web: When Israel had grown strong, they put the Canaanites to forced labor, and did not utterly drive them out.
verses.en_bbe: And whenever Israel became strong, they put the Canaanites to forced work, without driving them out completely.

verses.en: Neither did Ephraim drive out the Canaanites that dwelt in Gezer; but the Canaanites dwelt in Gezer among them.
verses.pt: Também Efraim não expulsou os cananeus que habitavam em Gezer; antes habitaram os cananeus em meio deles em Gezer.
verses.en_web: Ephraim didn’t drive out the Canaanites who lived in Gezer, but the Canaanites lived in Gezer among them.
verses.en_bbe: And Ephraim did not make the Canaanites who were living in Gezer go out; but the Canaanites went on living in Gezer among them.

verses.en: Neither did Zebulun drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites dwelt among them, and became tributaries.
verses.pt: Também Zebulom não expulsou aos que habitavam em Quitrom e aos que habitavam em Naalol; mas os cananeus habitaram no meio dele, e lhe foram tributários.
verses.en_web: Zebulun didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Kitron, nor the inhabitants of Nahalol; but the Canaanites lived among them, and became subject to forced labor.
verses.en_bbe: Zebulun did not make the people of Kitron or the people of Nahalol go out; but the Canaanites went on living among them and were put to forced work.

verses.en: Neither did Asher drive out the inhabitants of Accho, nor the inhabitants of Zidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob:
verses.pt: Também Aser não expulsou aos que habitavam em Aco, e aos que habitavam em Sidom, Alabe, Aczibe, Helba, Afeque, e em Reobe;
verses.en_web: Asher didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Acco, nor the inhabitants of Sidon, nor of Ahlab, nor of Achzib, nor of Helbah, nor of Aphik, nor of Rehob;
verses.en_bbe: And Asher did not take the land of the people of Acco, or Zidon, or Ahlab, or Achzib, or Helbah, or Aphik, or Rehob, driving them out;

verses.en: But the Asherites dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: for they did not drive them out.
verses.pt: em vez disso, Aser morou entre os cananeus que habitavam na terra; pois não os expulsou.
verses.en_web: but the Asherites lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land; for they did not drive them out.
verses.en_bbe: But the Asherites went on living among the Canaanites, the people of the land, without driving them out.

verses.en: Neither did Naphtali drive out the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth-anath; but he dwelt among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land: nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth-shemesh and of Beth-anath became tributaries unto them.
verses.pt: Também Naftali não expulsou os que habitavam em Bete-Semes e os que habitavam em Bete-Anate, mas morou entre os cananeus que habitavam na terra; todavia, os moradores de Bete-Semes e os moradores de Bete-Anate foram-lhe tributários.
verses.en_web: Naphtali didn’t drive out the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh, nor the inhabitants of Beth Anath; but he lived among the Canaanites, the inhabitants of the land. Nevertheless the inhabitants of Beth Shemesh and of Beth Anath became subject to forced labor.
verses.en_bbe: Naphtali did not take the land of the people of Beth-shemesh or of Beth-anath, driving them out; but he was living among the Canaanites in the land; however, the people of Beth-shemesh and Beth-anath were put to forced work.

verses.en: And the Amorites forced the children of Dan into the mountain: for they would not suffer them to come down to the valley:
verses.pt: Os amorreus pressionaram os filhos de Dã até as montanhas; pois não os permitiram descer ao vale.
verses.en_web: The Amorites forced the children of Dan into the hill country, for they would not allow them to come down to the valley;
verses.en_bbe: And the children of Dan were forced into the hill-country by the Amorites, who would not let them come down into the valley;

verses.en: But the Amorites would dwell in mount Heres in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim: yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became tributaries.
verses.pt: E os amorreus quiseram habitar no monte de Heres, em Aijalom e em Saalbim; mas a mão da tribo de José foi mais forte, e os fizeram tributários.
verses.en_web: but the Amorites would dwell in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim. Yet the hand of the house of Joseph prevailed, so that they became subject to forced labor.
verses.en_bbe: For the Amorites would go on living in Mount Heres, in Aijalon, and in Shaalbim; but the children of Joseph became stronger than they, and put them to forced work.

verses.en: And the coast of the Amorites was from the going up to Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
verses.pt: E o limite dos amorreus foi desde a subida de Acrabim, desde a rocha, e daí acima.
verses.en_web: The border of the Amorites was from the ascent of Akrabbim, from the rock, and upward.
verses.en_bbe: And the limit of the Edomites went from the slope of Akrabbim from Sela and up.
